intents.text:
She typed “Sure” before checking her calendar. Then she tried one honest sentence:
我今天不方便。
Wǒ jīntiān bù fāngbiàn.
Today doesn’t work for me.

不方便 bù fāngbiàn = inconvenient / not convenient. A boundary can be clear without becoming a speech.

The favor arrived. Her evening was already full. This time, she paused:
让我想一想。
Ràng wǒ xiǎng yi xiǎng.
Let me think about it.

You don’t need an instant yes. 想一想 means think it over; the repeated verb makes the action sound brief.

source: Owner-approved Nov5 boundary psychology theme; fresh X adaptation, no claim of matching unavailable Instagram master.
